name: insight-desktop
description: 因赛AI的跨平台 Harness 桌面宿主。
author: DataElement

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:core-runtime && npm run prepare:runtime-manifest && npm run build:desktop-integration && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: npm run prepare:core-runtime && npm run build:prepared
scripts.build:prepared: npm run prepare:runtime-manifest && npm run build:desktop-integration && electron-vite build
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:dev:dir: npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.dev.cjs
scripts.package:dev:mac:arm64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin arm64 && npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs
scripts.package:dev:mac:x64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin x64 && npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs && electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs
scripts.package:dev:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin arm64 && npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin x64 && npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run build && npm run prepare:bundled-profile && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
